newsitem.title: USA: Iron Computer Corp announces Internet IPO.
newsitem.headline: Iron Computer Corp announces Internet IPO.

text.p: Iron Computer Corp said Tuesday it will begin its $3 per share initial public offering of 3.3 million shares June 16 via its web site.

The company, a product of a University of Texas business incubator program, produces personal computers for "hostile environments," such as warehouse, machine shops, construction sites, car washes and fast food restaurants, it said.
The company has registered the offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission, it said. It will not be listed on a stock exchange.
Stock may be ordered through the Internet at http://www.ironipo.com, it said.
